baselineReproduction: EXACT on value and state, 115/115; authority measured not simulated
basis: Zero recovery in every arm: correct selections stay at 29 of 115 under G1P0, G0P1 and G1P1
13 candidates suppressed under G1P1 and not one converted a wrong selection into a correct one
No collateral either: zero regressions, wrong OBSERVED stays 0, Brand-absent positives stay 0
methodologicalFinding: The 11 targets were identified from winners under the E+S-prime counterfactual, but this experiment runs on unmodified production ranking, where those cases have different winners. The treatment was derived in one ranking regime and applied in another.
